Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value From activities Join assays On activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id Join molecule_dictionary On activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno Left Join compound_structures On molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno Filter activities.standard_relation = '=' And activities.pchembl_value Is Not Null And assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens' And target_dictionary.tid = 2164 And target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' And activities.activity_type = 'IC50' Sort molecule_chembl_id Asc assay_chembl_id Asc canonical_smiles Asc target_type Asc tax_id Asc standard_type Asc pchembl_value Asc Limit 1000
